passages.label: Si. Mi chiamano Mimì (Andante lento, D major)
Mi chiamano Mimì, il perchè non so (Lentamente)
Sola mi fo il pranzo da me stessa (Allegretto moderato)
Ma quando vien lo sgelo (Andante molto sostenuto)
Germoglia in un vaso una rosa (I° tempo, Andante agitando appena)
Ma i fior ch'io faccio, ahimè! (I tempo, ma calmo, to the end)

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)

licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. Tempo from the printed metronome marks; where none is printed, a value chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
